gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: The old cinema was knocked ___ to build a car park.
gaps.explanation: knock down = demolish a building; hit with a vehicle.

gaps.sentence: He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: Her essay stands ___ from the rest of the class.
gaps.explanation: stand out = be easy to notice, be better/different.

gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: I can't figure ___ how this app works.
She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.
